text: シルバースプレーは　よわい　ポケモンが　とびでて　こなくなる　ほう！

structure.jp: よわい　ポケモンが　とびでて　こなくなる

patterns.name: 〜なくなる
patterns.explanation: The 'not' form of a verb plus なる says something stops happening. こなくなる = 'stop coming'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.span: とびでて　こなくなる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て-form verb says the action comes toward you. とびでて こなくなる = 'stop jumping out at you'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: よわい　ポケモンが　とびでて　こなくなる　ほう
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a word describes it. Here it describes ほう, 'the one of the two'. よわい ポケモンが とびでて こなくなる ほう = 'the one that stops weak Pokémon jumping out'.
